decks.notes: The deck focuses on controlling the board through removal spells, counterspells, and card advantage to outvalue the opponent. It utilizes versatile creatures like Ice-Fang Coatl and Omnath, Locus of Creation for a strong board presence. The addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad allows for extra value by blinking key permanents. The mana base is designed to support a variety of colors for maximum flexibility in playing spells. The deck aims to grind out opponents with incremental advantages and overwhelming them with powerful threats.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Omnath, Locus of Creation. It also utilizes cards like Expressive Iteration and Wrenn and Six to generate card advantage and recur important spells or lands. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for extra value through blinking permanents like Ice-Fang Coatl and Eternal Witness. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistency in casting spells.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating value through cards like Eternal Witness and Omnath, Locus of Creation. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional value through blinking creatures and permanents. The mana base is designed to support the deck's powerful spells with a mix of dual lands and fetch lands. Ultimately, the deck seeks to out-value and outmaneuver the opponent in order to secure victory.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Murktide Regent, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while utilizing efficient counterspells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce to protect your threats. Mishra's Bauble and Consider help to filter through your deck and find key cards, while Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt provide removal and reach. The mana base is streamlined with fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent access to all colors of mana needed for your spells.

A deck focused on quickly equipping a creature with Colossus Hammer to deal massive damage to the opponent. The deck uses cards like Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to quickly find and equip the hammer, while also protecting the creature with Giver of Runes and Sigarda's Aid. Urza's Saga is also utilized to find key artifacts like Colossus Hammer. Overall, the strategy revolves around assembling the combo pieces and overwhelming the opponent with a powerful, evasive creature equipped with the hammer.

The main concept of this Modern 1 vs 1 Combo - Living End deck is to cycle through your deck quickly and efficiently using cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will, while disrupting your opponent's strategy with cards like Grief and Force of Negation. The goal is to eventually cast Living End to bring back all of your creatures from the graveyard, overwhelming your opponent with a powerful board presence. The inclusion of cards like Subtlety and Brazen Borrower provide additional flexibility and disruption to your game plan.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly casting powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while disrupting the opponent with counterspells and removal spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt. The deck also includes card draw spells like Consider and Expressive Iteration to ensure card advantage. The mana base is designed to provide consistent access to both blue and red mana sources, allowing for flexibility in casting spells. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control of the game throughout.

The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Power Plant, and Mine) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It leverages this mana advantage to control the game through powerful colorless spells like Karn Liberated, Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, and Walking Ballista. The deck also employs tools like Oblivion Stone and Relic of Progenitus to disrupt opponent strategies and slow down their game plan. With the ability to tutor for specific pieces with Expedition Map and Ancient Stirrings, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents in a grindy control match-up.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board and hand while generating card advantage through flickering effects and recursion. It aims to stall the game with counterspells and removal until it can establish a dominant position on the battlefield using powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Teferi, Time Raveler. The deck utilizes a variety of land types to support its flexible mana base and has access to a diverse range of answers to handle different threats. It ultimately seeks to grind out its opponent with incremental advantages and overwhelming value.

The deck focuses on controlling the board through a mix of removal spells, counterspells, and versatile creatures like Ice-Fang Coatl and Eternal Witness. It aims to generate card advantage and value through cards like Yorion, Sky Nomad, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Expressive Iteration. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Wrenn and Six and Omnath, Locus of Creation to generate incremental advantages. The mana base is designed to provide access to various colors and ensure consistency in casting spells. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents in a longer game.

This deck focuses on quickly casting creatures and spells with cascade to overwhelm the opponent with aggression. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cascade into powerful threats like Crashing Footfalls, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and often. The deck also includes disruption and removal spells like Force of Negation and Fury to control the board and protect its own threats. Overall, this deck aims to win the game quickly through a combination of efficient creatures and powerful cascade spells.

This combo deck focuses on using Colossus Hammer in combination with Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to quickly equip a creature for massive damage. The deck also includes efficient mana ramp and protection cards like Giver of Runes and Esper Sentinel to help the combo go off smoothly. With cards like Urza's Saga and Sigarda's Aid to provide additional support, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces as quickly as possible to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful, unexpected attack.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through powerful Elemental creatures and versatile spells. It utilizes cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation, Solitude, and Fury to control the board while generating value. The deck also includes cards like Risen Reef and Wrenn and Six for card advantage and ramp. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value by blinking creatures and permanents. The mana base is designed to support the variety of colors needed for the deck's powerful spells and creatures.

The deck focuses on using Elemental creatures with powerful abilities to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It also includes a companion creature, Kaheera, the Orphanguard, to provide additional value and synergy. The deck utilizes cards like Solitude, Fury, and Omnath, Locus of Creation to deal with threats, while Risen Reef and Titania, Protector of Argoth generate additional advantage. The inclusion of Teferi, Time Raveler helps to protect the board and disrupt the opponent's spells. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent's threats and establish a dominant board presence.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of powerful creatures and spells, with a particular emphasis on Elementals. The strategy involves ramping mana with Utopia Sprawl and Abundant Growth, while utilizing cards like Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation to generate value and card advantage. The deck also includes a range of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending to deal with opposing threats. With Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion, the deck aims to outvalue opponents over the course of a long game, while utilizing cards like Wrenn and Six and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the battlefield.

This aggressive Modern deck focuses on quickly dealing damage to the opponent using low-cost spells and efficient creatures to win the game before the opponent can stabilize. The deck's key strategy is to cast cheap burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to clear the way for creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler to deal damage directly to the opponent. The deck also includes card draw spells like Light Up the Stage and Reckless Impulse to help maintain momentum and close out the game quickly.
